title: vat workspace manifest, version 1
description: The single declaration of which repositories a workspace governs. Normative prose is docs/SPEC.md section 4; where the two disagree, SPEC.md is the specification and this file has a bug.

version.description: Manifest schema version. An implementation MUST refuse a version it does not understand rather than read it partially.

requires.description: What this workspace demands of the tool operating it, as opposed to `version`, which is what it demands of the reader of this file. A schema version does not pin command behaviour.

vat.description: Space-separated comparison terms that must all hold, e.g. ">=0.3.0 <0.4.0". Operators are >=, >, <=, <, =. Caret and tilde ranges are not this format's and MUST be refused rather than ignored. A tool whose own version cannot be read MUST NOT treat the constraint as violated.

default_branch.description: Branch vat treats as the trunk of a repository that names none of its own.

remote_template.description: URL template for created repositories. MUST contain {name}: without it every repository is handed the same origin, and two repositories sharing an upstream fetch and push over each other. MUST NOT embed a credential; vat.yaml is committed.

checks.description: Canonical commands that prove the control plane itself is healthy. The workspace root is a repository too, but it is not in `repos:` and cannot be, so its checks live here. Read when a changeset enrols the workspace as the participant named ".".

allow_autostash.description: Whether an update may stash a dirty working tree. Turning this on gives up the guarantee that vat never silently modifies uncommitted work.

trust.description: Which content an agent may treat as instruction and which is data. A harness that names no untrusted sources cannot tell an agent which text is data.

gates.description: A gate is crossed by a human or not gated at all; there is deliberately no middle value.

role.description: What a repository is canonical for. Checks, harness templates, and lint rules all branch on it.

name.description: Becomes a directory name and a path segment in a remote URL, so it is bounded by what a git host already accepts.

origin.description: MUST NOT embed a credential. vat.yaml is committed, so a token pasted here is published by the next push of the workspace root.

access.description: Metadata for humans and for the harness. The manifest records identity, not access.
